subject.title: fix: generated images do not appear in native chat

question: Should ticketed managed-image downloads forward a narrowly defined set of configured reverse-proxy routing headers, and if so which headers are safe to carry without recreating the Gateway credential leak?
rationale: The current implementation and its test intentionally omit all custom headers, while the new public client contract says reverse-proxy headers are required; selecting a safe allowlist or a ticket-only proxy contract is a security and deployment-policy choice.

options.title: Define a safe routing-header contract
options.body: Specify and implement an artifact-request allowlist for necessary proxy-routing headers while continuing to exclude Gateway authorization credentials.

options.title: Require ticket-only proxy access
options.body: Keep native requests header-free and require deployments to expose the ticketed media route without custom proxy headers, then document and test that limitation.

options.title: Pause for a shared media-auth design
options.body: Defer this cross-client change until the Gateway has a generic native-media authorization contract that covers proxied deployments.

recommendation.title: Define a safe routing-header contract
recommendation.body: Specify and implement an artifact-request allowlist for necessary proxy-routing headers while continuing to exclude Gateway authorization credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier proposal and investigation covered the same iOS managed-media authorization boundary.
